name: gtfs
label: GTFS (Transit)
description: General Transit Feed Specification — used by every transit authority

table_notes.agency: One row per transit operator; a single feed may contain multiple agencies sharing routes.
table_notes.stops: Physical locations where passengers board or alight; also models station entrances and generic nodes via location_type.
table_notes.routes: A named service grouping trips by direction; route_type codes follow the GTFS extended route type table.
table_notes.calendar: Weekly service bitmask (0/1 per day) plus a validity window; drives which trips run on which dates.
table_notes.trips: A single vehicle run along a route; links a route, a calendar service, and an optional shape for map display.
table_notes.stop_times: Ordered arrival/departure schedule for every stop on a trip; the largest table in any GTFS feed.
table_notes.calendar_dates: Exceptions to the regular calendar (added or removed service), e.g. public holidays or special events.
table_notes.shapes: Ordered sequence of lat/lng waypoints describing the on-road geometry of a trip’s path for map rendering.
table_notes.fare_attributes: Pricing rules per fare class including currency, payment method, and transfer allowance.

agency.name: agency_id
agency.description: Unique identifier for the transit operator (primary key, referenced by routes.agency_id)

agency.name: agency_name
agency.description: Full public name of the transit agency as displayed to riders

agency.name: agency_url
agency.description: Public website URL for the agency

agency.name: agency_timezone
agency.description: IANA timezone for interpreting all times in this feed (e.g. America/New_York)

agency.name: agency_lang
agency.description: ISO 639-1 primary language code used in agency communications

agency.name: agency_phone
agency.description: Voice telephone number for passenger information or customer service

agency.name: agency_fare_url
agency.description: URL of a web page where riders can purchase tickets or view fare information

agency.name: agency_email
agency.description: Contact email address for rider feedback or customer service

stops.name: stop_id
stops.description: Unique identifier for this stop or station node (referenced by stop_times.stop_id)

stops.name: stop_code
stops.description: Short public-facing code displayed on signage and in rider-facing apps

stops.name: stop_name
stops.description: Human-readable name of the stop as shown to passengers

stops.name: stop_desc
stops.description: Prose description of the stop location to help riders identify it

stops.name: stop_lat
stops.description: WGS84 latitude of the stop in decimal degrees

stops.name: stop_lon
stops.description: WGS84 longitude of the stop in decimal degrees

stops.name: location_type
stops.description: GTFS location type: 0=stop, 1=station, 2=station entrance, 3=generic node, 4=boarding area

stops.name: parent_station
stops.description: References stops.stop_id of the parent station that contains this stop or entrance

stops.name: wheelchair_boarding
stops.description: Wheelchair accessibility: 0=no info, 1=accessible path exists, 2=no accessible path

stops.name: platform_code
stops.description: Platform identifier within a multi-platform station (e.g. “3A”, “North”)

routes.name: route_id
routes.description: Unique identifier for this route (referenced by trips.route_id)

routes.name: agency_id
routes.description: References agency.agency_id of the operator running this route

routes.name: route_short_name
routes.description: Short public designation shown on vehicles and signage (e.g. “42”, “Red Line”)

routes.name: route_long_name
routes.description: Full descriptive name of the route shown in schedules (e.g. “Downtown Express”)

routes.name: route_desc
routes.description: Additional description of the route’s purpose or operating pattern

routes.name: route_url
routes.description: URL of a web page with schedule or service information specific to this route

routes.name: route_color
routes.description: 6-digit hex RGB color used to render this route on maps (no leading #)

routes.name: route_text_color
routes.description: 6-digit hex RGB color for text drawn over route_color for legible contrast

calendar.name: service_id
calendar.description: Unique service pattern identifier (referenced by trips.service_id and calendar_dates.service_id)

calendar.name: monday
calendar.description: Service runs on Mondays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: tuesday
calendar.description: Service runs on Tuesdays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: wednesday
calendar.description: Service runs on Wednesdays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: thursday
calendar.description: Service runs on Thursdays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: friday
calendar.description: Service runs on Fridays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: saturday
calendar.description: Service runs on Saturdays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: sunday
calendar.description: Service runs on Sundays within the date window: 1=yes, 0=no

calendar.name: start_date
calendar.description: First date this service pattern is active (inclusive)

calendar.name: end_date
calendar.description: Last date this service pattern is active (inclusive)

trips.name: trip_id
trips.description: Unique identifier for this vehicle run (referenced by stop_times.trip_id)

trips.name: route_id
trips.description: References routes.route_id of the route this trip belongs to

trips.name: service_id
trips.description: References calendar.service_id defining which days this trip operates

trips.name: trip_headsign
trips.description: Destination text displayed on the vehicle’s front sign (e.g. “Downtown”)

trips.name: direction_id
trips.description: Travel direction for distinguishing outbound/inbound: 0=one direction, 1=opposite direction

trips.name: block_id
trips.description: Groups consecutive trips served by the same physical vehicle (for through-service)

trips.name: shape_id
trips.description: References shapes.shape_id defining the geographic path drawn on maps for this trip

trips.name: wheelchair_accessible
trips.description: Wheelchair accessibility of the vehicle: 0=no info, 1=accessible, 2=not accessible

stop_times.name: id
stop_times.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key (GTFS stop_times has no natural PK)

stop_times.name: trip_id
stop_times.description: References trips.trip_id of the vehicle run this stop time belongs to

stop_times.name: stop_id
stop_times.description: References stops.stop_id of the physical stop visited at this point in the trip

stop_times.name: stop_sequence
stop_times.description: Non-negative integer ordering stops within a trip (does not need to be consecutive)

stop_times.name: arrival_time
stop_times.description: Scheduled arrival time offset from service-day midnight (can exceed 24h for overnight runs)

stop_times.name: departure_time
stop_times.description: Scheduled departure time offset from service-day midnight (can exceed 24h for overnight runs)

stop_times.name: stop_headsign
stop_times.description: Override headsign text shown on the vehicle from this stop onward (overrides trip_headsign)

stop_times.name: pickup_type
stop_times.description: Passenger pickup policy: 0=regular, 1=no pickup, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver

stop_times.name: drop_off_type
stop_times.description: Passenger drop-off policy: 0=regular, 1=no drop-off, 2=phone agency, 3=coordinate with driver

calendar_dates.name: service_id
calendar_dates.description: References calendar.service_id whose normal schedule is being overridden on this date

calendar_dates.name: date
calendar_dates.description: The specific calendar date to which this exception applies

calendar_dates.name: exception_type
calendar_dates.description: Type of exception: 1=service added on this date, 2=service removed on this date

shapes.name: shape_id
shapes.description: Groups all points belonging to one route path (referenced by trips.shape_id)

shapes.name: shape_pt_lat
shapes.description: WGS84 latitude of this waypoint in decimal degrees

shapes.name: shape_pt_lon
shapes.description: WGS84 longitude of this waypoint in decimal degrees

shapes.name: shape_pt_sequence
shapes.description: Ordering integer for waypoints within a shape (ascending, not necessarily contiguous)

fare_attributes.name: fare_id
fare_attributes.description: Unique identifier for this fare class (referenced by fare rules if present)

fare_attributes.name: price
fare_attributes.description: Fare price in the units specified by currency_type

fare_attributes.name: currency_type
fare_attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the fare amount (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

fare_attributes.name: payment_method
fare_attributes.description: When fare is paid: 0=on board, 1=before boarding

fare_attributes.name: transfers
fare_attributes.description: Number of transfers permitted: 0=none, 1=one transfer, 2=two transfers, NULL=unlimited

fare_attributes.name: transfer_duration
fare_attributes.description: Seconds within which a transfer is valid after initial fare payment

short_description: General Transit Feed Specification — used by every transit authority
long_description: GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) is the universal format for publishing public transit schedules and geographic data. The schema covers agencies, stops, routes, calendar service patterns, trips, and stop times — the complete set of GTFS Static tables plus fare attributes.
when_to_use: Use for transit applications, trip planning tools, mobility-as-a-service (MaaS) platforms, or any system that needs to work with public transit data. Cities and transit agencies in 100+ countries publish GTFS. Many jurisdictions legally require agencies to publish GTFS data. Google Maps, Apple Maps, and all major navigation apps consume GTFS.
